adaptation.runtimeInputConversion: Remove old nativeHands.version descriptor; retain only supported twistShare; explicitly select current model and per-side hand pose.
method: Retain the action semantics, timing and intended fixed support points.
Evaluate the actual short-arm rig with the fixed symmetric hand source; calibrate floor orientation and wrist height from the matching saved support preset.
Compare actual body contact/limb reach at key poses; if source absolute targets do not fit, author a separate spec revision using new bind pivots/segment lengths.
Do not scale every coordinate, relax QA thresholds, or silently use a changed model/pose.
adaptation.specificRisk: Deep hip compression plus old hip-frame ankle targets and knee-plane derived foot rotations need full path checking. Opposite circle direction at 5 seconds must not introduce an orientation branch jump.
implemented: Current armfix hip pivots and thigh/shin lengths in new body-aware helper
Original floor anchors retained; arm reach solver reconciles current body
Full forearm axial share avoids half-share wrap discontinuity
Fixed camera and latest explicit support/relaxed hand recipes

source.priorReviewScope: historical source preparation, not current model or visual approval

reviewPlan.intent: A ten-second continuous support sequence demonstrates one leg circle in each direction between L and V positions.
reviewPlan.cameraReason: Moderately elevated three-quarter front view reveals both the opening width and raised-leg height.
points: Include widest straddle, highest V, direction reversal and return-to-L in the fixed crop.
Feet rotate with the shin without extra full turns; check throughout both circle directions.
Hands remain fixed while hip compression changes; no backward whole-body substitution.
Both knees keep their source straightness requirement.
continuousOrientation: Inspect actual local/world hand and foot quaternions across the entire sampled path and across the loop seam.
Use quaternion sign continuity and incremental shortest-arc angles; equal start/end directions do not exclude a 180/360-degree twist inside the cycle.
Compare palm/sole normals and finger/toe directions against forearm/shin direction on both sides.
Flag abrupt Euler/axis-angle branch changes for actual skeleton and image review; do not declare a defect from Euler magnitude alone.
Inspect visible wrist and ankle deformation through intermediate frames; quaternion continuity alone does not certify a natural shape.

leftHand.note: Floor wrist pose is supplied by the active hand adapter; source finger/normal checks cannot certify its wrist rotation.

rightHand.note: Floor wrist pose is supplied by the active hand adapter; source finger/normal checks cannot certify its wrist rotation.

limits: Composed source foot rotations are inspected before IK and model transforms. Actual wrist and ankle quaternions and visible deformation still need rendering.
A large Euler value or cumulative path is only a review lead, not a defect verdict.

reviewPlan.propPolicy: The existing thin support mat remains an explicit prop. Its visible extent belongs to the fixed whole-cycle content rectangle; no separate ground-shadow layer.

risks: Deep hip compression plus old hip-frame ankle targets and knee-plane derived foot rotations need full path checking. Opposite circle direction at 5 seconds must not introduce an orientation branch jump.
armfix-r2 does not migrate old r5 contact calibration or P4/P5 appearance corrections automatically.
The saved support shape is an unreviewed legacy-mesh candidate; accepted dumbbell/wrist-r4 geometry is not a support-hand approval.
No new preview or full-cycle visual approval was performed while preparing this recipe.

appearance.purpose: Visual cue for target muscle effort, not a physiological measurement

templateReview.scope: New body corrective combination must be replayed; historical motion/camera approval remains bound to its original evidence.
